summary: Namco's dream-world 2.5D platform series, covering the PlayStation and PS2 main games, handheld puzzle-platformers, a volleyball spin-off, and the modern Phantasy Reverie remaster collection.

entries.title: Klonoa: Door to Phantomile

emulation.emulator: Native PC; DuckStation for PlayStation original; Dolphin for Wii remake
emulation.notes: Use Steam for the main run. Emulate PS1/Wii only to compare original/remake presentation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC remaster up to the collection's 4K/60 FPS target.

primary.why: The PC version of Klonoa Phantasy Reverie Series is the highest-fidelity current route for Door to Phantomile, with the remastered presentation, 60 FPS and up to 4K support documented for the collection, plus clean capture on PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play Door to Phantomile through Klonoa Phantasy Reverie Series on Steam. Use the PlayStation original or Wii remake only for historical comparison with the original presentation/remake lineage.

entries.remaster_caveats: Phantasy Reverie is a remaster/remake-derived route, not a one-to-one preservation of the 1997 PlayStation release.

emulation.notes: Use a WonderSwan core with integer scaling for clean monochrome capture.

primary.why: Moonlight Museum is documented as a WonderSwan-only Japan release, so the original handheld version is the only complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the WonderSwan release on original hardware or through a WonderSwan-capable emulator such as ares or Mednafen for capture.

entries.title: Klonoa: Empire of Dreams

emulation.notes: Use integer scaling and a neutral shader for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: GBA pixel art scaled cleanly on PC.

primary.why: Empire of Dreams is a GBA puzzle-platformer with later wrapper releases, but the original GBA version through a strong emulator gives the cleanest capture and control over scaling.
primary.how_to_play: Play the GBA release in mGBA with integer scaling and clean pixel output. Nintendo Switch Online is a convenient official route if the subscription library is preferred.

entries.remaster_caveats: Wii U Virtual Console and Nintendo Switch Online are emulation wrappers, not remasters.

entries.title: Klonoa Phantasy Reverie Series

emulation.notes: Use the Steam release for capture. Original-console emulation is only needed for historical comparisons.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC remaster up to the collection's 4K/60 FPS target.

primary.why: Phantasy Reverie Series bundles remasters of Door to Phantomile and Lunatea's Veil; the PC release is the best archive version because it preserves the remastered feature set while giving the cleanest capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Steam version on PC. Set the output resolution for capture, then play both included games from the collection.

entries.remaster_caveats: Door to Phantomile's remaster is based on the 2008 Wii remake lineage, while Lunatea's Veil is remastered from the PS2 original.
